key.name: enabled
key.description: When enabled, the desktop wallpaper changes automatically at the configured interval.

key.name: interval-minutes
key.description: How long each wallpaper is shown, in minutes. The lower bound is one minute; the upper bound is one day.

key.name: directory
key.description: Absolute path to a folder of images. When empty, the folder of the current wallpaper is used, so the plugin does something sensible without being configured first.

key.name: shuffle
key.summary: Choose the next wallpaper at random
key.description: When enabled, the next wallpaper is chosen at random, avoiding an immediate repeat. When disabled, wallpapers are shown in filename order.
